strategy.thesis: Telefónica's corporate accelerator and open-innovation arm. Operates a venture-client model connecting startups with Telefónica's business units and ~350M+ customer base; ~75% synergy-driven investments aligned with Telefónica's needs, ~25% opportunistic tech bets.

program.location: Madrid, Barcelona, Munich, London and other hubs
program.eligibility: Startups from Europe and Israel with a working product and a concrete use case for Telefónica.

summary.en: Wayra is Telefónica's corporate accelerator and open-innovation/CVC platform, founded in 2011 and headquartered in Madrid, with hubs in Spain, Germany, the UK and Brazil. It runs a roughly 4-month, no-fee program (12–15 startups/year) with €25K–€50K grants and follow-on investment tickets of €50K–€5M, connecting startups to Telefónica's business units via a venture-client model.
summary.local: Wayra es la aceleradora corporativa y plataforma de innovación abierta de Telefónica, fundada en 2011 con sede en Madrid. Opera un modelo venture-client que conecta startups con las unidades de negocio de Telefónica.
